title: The Comic Panel Left Blank for Them
youtube_title: The Comic Panel Left Blank for Them | Bedtime Story for Kids in English
moral: Staying beside someone is sometimes the whole gift.
summary: At a bedroom rug of cushions, puppets, and paper, Jasper is just outside the fun, close to a comic panel left blank on purpose. Kei changes the seating, the rules, or the pace so Jasper has a real place, not a prize announced out loud. Papa lets the children solve it.
